bio.text: Chris Baum is the Approval Voting Party candidate for U.S. Senate in Colorado in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Washington, D.C., and served in the U.S. Navy from 1963 to 1967, including as a supply officer.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 1967 and a graduate degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 1979, and has worked as an information systems administrator, small business owner and computer consultant.
